title: The Ledger
summary: The Ledger is a meta-page that records corrections and verdicts from two hostile audits. It kills several overclaims, reduces others, and preserves a core of results that survived. The page itself is honest about its own status, but some claims still carry risks of overstatement or unproven derivations.

claims.claim_text: The veto architecture is repaired by restating the product over normalized global sector scores, χ = ∏ηᵢ with 0 ≤ ηᵢ ≤ 1, where one zeroed sector collapses the whole.
evidence_needed: Formal proof that the normalized product collapses when any ηᵢ = 0.
evidence_present: Statement of the repaired form and its property.
evidence_gap: No formal derivation or Lean proof provided in this work.
support: 'it is repaired by restating the product over normalized global sector scores, χ = ∏ηᵢ with 0 ≤ ηᵢ ≤ 1, where one zeroed sector genuinely collapses the whole.'
risks: The claim is stated as a repair but not formally proven here.
claims.kill_condition: If a counterexample shows a zeroed ηᵢ does not collapse the product under the defined normalization.
claims.required_concession: This is a proposed repair, not yet formally verified.

claims.claim_text: The four forms (product, ratio, dynamic, field) are formal model forms, not yet operationally validated physics.
evidence_present: Explicit scope label in the work.
support: 'these are formal model forms, not yet operationally validated physics.'

claims.claim_text: A bound state at the minimum of one potential exhibits seven of nine fruits as properties of one system expanded around one equilibrium.
evidence_needed: Hessian/perturbation-spectrum derivation showing each fruit as a property of the bound state.
evidence_present: List of seven fruits mapped to physical properties (minimum energy, oscillation frequency, etc.).
evidence_gap: The derivation is owed, not yet provided.
support: 'a bound state at the minimum of one potential genuinely exhibits, from that single equilibrium: minimum energy (love), oscillation frequency from curvature (joy), force balance (peace), thermal response (patience), activation energy (kindness), extractable work (goodness), and Noether conservation from time symmetry (faithfulness)'
risks: The mapping is asserted but not derived; gentleness and self-control are not yet included.
claims.kill_condition: If the Hessian derivation fails to produce the claimed properties.
claims.required_concession: The derivation is owed; currently this is a plausible mapping, not a proven derivation.

claims.claim_text: The Maxwell coupling invariant is the strongest formal result: quaternion EM and Trinity relational structure pass the same gates; Heaviside vector reduction and modalism fail the same gates; adversarial controls prove the gates are load-bearing; a scalar-vector coupling theorem shows vector-only data cannot reconstruct the full product.
evidence_needed: Lean 4 proof with zero sorry; definition-ablation matrix to address reverse-engineering objection.
evidence_present: Machine-verified in Lean 4, zero sorry; guard-removal controls.
support: 'adversarial controls prove the gates are load-bearing (remove a guard and the broken form passes)'
claims.kill_condition: If definition-ablation matrix shows the gates were reverse-engineered.
claims.required_concession: The claim wears a caveat: Lean-verified inside declared axioms; definition-ablation matrix is pending.

claims.claim_text: Consciousness derived from χ-field equilibrium properties is overstated; the properties do not discriminate conscious from non-conscious systems.
evidence_needed: A property that distinguishes conscious from non-conscious systems.
evidence_present: Kill test: a non-conscious scalar field satisfies all stated equilibrium conditions.
support: 'a completely non-conscious scalar field satisfies every stated equilibrium condition'
claims.required_concession: The claim is reduced to a substrate model with structural analogues.

claims.claim_text: The internal-regress argument stands: self-interpretation cannot ground itself; the regress has three exits; infinite regress and brute terminus fail; a self-grounding terminus requires internal differentiation.
evidence_needed: Support for the agency premise and the secular-triad test.
evidence_present: Structural analogy to Gödel, Tarski, Turing; three exits listed.
evidence_gap: Agency premise not fully wired; secular-triad test pending.
support: 'self-interpretation cannot ground itself (the structural lesson of Gödel, Tarski, Turing – applied as structural analogy, flagged as such)'
dependencies: Gödel, Tarski, Turing as structural analogy
claims.kill_condition: If the agency premise is shown to be unjustified.
claims.required_concession: Two named holes are open: agency premise and secular-triad test.

claims.claim_text: The 7Q Eliminator is reduced to a Christian metaphysical constraint framework for comparing worldviews, not a universal eliminator of 59 worldviews.
evidence_needed: Rival-authored boundary conditions to test motivated selection.
evidence_present: Concession box already conceded most of this.
evidence_gap: Rival-authored boundary conditions not yet tested.
support: 'Reduced to what it demonstrably is: a Christian metaphysical constraint framework for comparing worldviews'
claims.required_concession: The final 8/8 verdict is exposed to motivated-selection objection until rival boundary conditions are tested.

claims.claim_text: The Ten Laws Portrait is corrected to ten physical structures, not ten forces; the page is devotional architecture, not a lab result.
support: 'The portrait is devotional architecture, and it is better devotional architecture when it stops claiming to be a lab result.'

claims.claim_text: Noether's theorem is domain-general mathematics: any Lagrangian system with a continuous symmetry has a conserved quantity; the real chain requires the modeling premise that moral dynamics admit a time-translation-invariant Lagrangian description.
evidence_needed: Formal proof of Noether's theorem; explicit statement of the modeling premise as an axiom.
evidence_present: Noether's theorem stated; premise now explicit.
evidence_gap: The moral Lagrangian is not constructed; Γ_sin factors lack operationalization.
support: 'Noether is domain-general mathematics: any Lagrangian system with a continuous symmetry has a conserved quantity'
'The premise is now stated as an explicit axiom, on the page, where a physicist can attack it'
risks: The moral Lagrangian is not given; the premise is an axiom, not derived.
claims.kill_condition: If the modeling premise is shown to be false or incoherent.
claims.required_concession: The premise is an axiom; the Γ_sin expression remains model-form analogy until operationalized.

claims.claim_text: The AXIOM Gap-Fill document is not canon-safe as written; it has mapping inconsistencies and a table with 19 rows for 18 variables.
support: 'Its "18 dependent variables" table has 19 rows and includes God as not-derived plus Faith as a generator.'

claims.claim_text: R(offense, α) and the Cross as unique solution: three variables (justice, mercy, free will) cannot be jointly maximized in two-party space; the unique solution requires a third party simultaneously judge and payer.
evidence_needed: Lean proof of uniqueness; independent derivation via mechanism design.
evidence_present: Machine-verified uniqueness in Lean; independent derivation via Myerson–Satterthwaite.
evidence_gap: Open questions: why every offense is representable as conserved payable cost; why non-penal alternatives cannot satisfy constraints.
support: 'Machine-verified uniqueness in Lean; independently re-derived by a different AI through mechanism design (Myerson–Satterthwaite: no two-party mechanism is efficient, individually rational, and budget-balanced – an external subsidizing party is required).'
claims.kill_condition: If a non-penal alternative is found that satisfies the three constraints.

claims.claim_text: The claim 'No premise smuggled. No step skipped.' is wrong; several steps carry substantive philosophical premises.
evidence_present: List of premises: relation reveals value, justice requires payment, source is personal.
support: 'Several steps carry substantive philosophical premises – relation reveals value, justice requires payment, the source is personal.'

claims.claim_text: The triadic termination structure is right: n=1 self-defeats, n=2 deadlocks or collapses a required invariant, n=3 unified passes, demonstrated across multiple domains.
evidence_present: Demonstrated across field coupling, measurement chain, moral optimization, internal regress, cosmological coordination.
evidence_gap: Upward bound (why not four?) is only a parsimony argument.
support: 'n = 1 self-defeats, n = 2 deadlocks or collapses a required invariant, n = 3 unified passes, demonstrated across field coupling, the measurement chain, moral optimization, internal regress, and (top-down) cosmological coordination'
claims.kill_condition: If a domain shows n=2 can satisfy all invariants.
claims.required_concession: Upward bound is a parsimony argument, not a proof.

claims.claim_text: The coupling gate battery is right: seven named failure modes, each with a Lean anchor.
evidence_needed: Lean proofs for each failure mode.
evidence_present: Seven named failure modes with Lean anchors.
evidence_gap: No details of the Lean proofs in this work.
support: 'Seven named failure modes, each with a Lean anchor: no coupling invariant, no distinctness, no dynamics, wrong role profile, relabeling without profile preservation, coupling without entanglement, closed self-source.'
claims.kill_condition: If any failure mode is shown to pass the gates.
claims.required_concession: The gates are designed to reject malformed triads; counterexamples must go through the gates.

claims.claim_text: The method of stating the strongest objection, distinguishing contradiction from missing bridge, searching for independent repair, and attacking again is the deepest result.
evidence_present: Both audits ran on this machinery.
support: 'State the strongest objection. Distinguish contradiction from missing bridge. Search for an independently derived repair. Attack the repaired claim again. Keep only what survives.'

claims.claim_text: The standing corrections queue includes definition-ablation matrix, Hessian derivation, secular triad through gates, agency premise wiring, Γ_sin operationalization, rival boundary conditions, Lean theorem count, and migration of normalized Master Equation form.
support: 'Standing corrections queue: Definition-ablation matrix for the Maxwell gates · Hessian derivation for the Fruits (and the gentleness/self-control question) · secular triad through the coupling gates · Stage 4–5 wiring for the regress argument's agency premise · operationalization of Γ_sin factors · rival-authored boundary conditions for 7Q · canonical Lean theorem count via the owner-map ledger (raw declaration counts are never cited publicly) · migration of the normalized-sector Master Equation form to every page that shows the old sentence.'

fixes.problem: The repaired Master Equation form is stated but not formally proven.
fixes.repair: Provide a formal proof or Lean verification that the normalized product collapses when any ηᵢ = 0.

fixes.problem: The Fruits derivation is owed but not provided.
fixes.repair: Complete the Hessian/perturbation-spectrum derivation and decide on gentleness/self-control.

fixes.problem: Definition-ablation matrix missing for Maxwell gates.
fixes.repair: Create and publish the definition-ablation matrix to address reverse-engineering objection.

fixes.problem: Moral Lagrangian not constructed; Γ_sin factors not operationalized.
fixes.repair: Construct a concrete moral Lagrangian or state why it cannot be done; operationalize each Γ_sin factor.

fixes.problem: Open questions on offense representability and non-penal alternatives.
fixes.repair: Address these open questions or explicitly mark them as unresolved.

log_notes: The Ledger is a meta-page that records corrections; many claims are admissions or reductions.
Several claims reference Lean proofs but details are not in this work; need to check linked pages.
The work itself is honest about its status, but some claims still carry risks of overstatement.
